name: Sorting Algorithms
description: Algorithms that put the elements of a list into order. The classic starting point for seeing how an algorithm works step by step.

name: Searching Algorithms
description: Algorithms that find a value in a collection, and show how much faster a search gets when the data is sorted.

name: Graph Algorithms
description: Algorithms that work on nodes connected by edges: exploring a graph, putting tasks in an order that respects their dependencies and finding the shortest paths.
